title: PII redaction
subtitle: Mask or block identifiers before a model sees the prompt.
enableHint: Applies to text in chat, completions, messages, responses, batches, embeddings, moderations, image prompts, speech input, the playground, and the assistant. Uploaded files and audio are not scanned.
outputHint: Strip PII from completions before they reach the client

groupsHint: Select or clear every entity in a group at once.
policyHint: Applies to every request unless its company or API key has an override.
entitiesHint: Without a selection, the default set applies.
overridesHint: Give a company or a single API key its own policy. A key override wins over its company, and everything else uses the global policy.
overridesEmpty: No overrides yet. Every request uses the global policy.
overrideHint: This policy fully replaces the inherited one for the selected company or API key: mode, output redaction, and entities.
removeConfirmHint: Requests then use the inherited policy again.
entityCount: {count, plural, =0 {Default set} one {# entity} other {# entities}}
logsHint: Request logs mark every entity this policy finds in prompts and responses, and stored log content is masked as well.
